per_question.q: (2) modkit vs MSA vs ISM pros/cons + application; replacement or complement?
per_question.verdict: COMPLEMENTARY extraction frontend, NOT a replacement
per_question.numbers: modkit: somatic-aware=NO, subclone-aware=NO (extraction/pileup; dmr=region-level diff not per-read somatic axis); 5mC/5hmC SEPARATE by default; external-citable=STRONG (ONT official). MSA: somatic HP/ALLELE-axis=YES (generated our dualaxis) but carries 5mC+5hmC double-row MAX-collapse bug (buggy BRCA2 -0.054 vs corrected -0.122); internal-only. ISM: per-read subclone clustering=YES (read-read distance + hierarchical, only dedicated resolver); internal-only.

per_question.q: (3) can modkit supply separated continuous 5mC+5hmC; did GMM re-test change any subclone verdict vs pysam-binarized M2?
per_question.verdict: PASS supply; but GMM re-test = NEGATIVE/NULL (no verdict change)
per_question.numbers: 13 tested: 9 bimodal under modkit-continuous; 3 CHANGED (n_lost=3, n_gained=0, n_5hmC_new_structure=0). Lost = chr2:4630990(n=68), chr7:155395399(n=44), chr9:23071370(n=28) — all small-n borderline, 5mC dBIC slipped 9.30/8.25/7.40 below the >=10 cutoff. BRCA2 UNIMODAL both methods. Consistent with M2 (binarized-vs-continuous corr=0.9979; corr_db_max_vs_5hmC=0.0331). Cleaner measurement is MORE CONSERVATIVE not more sensitive; separating 5hmC revealed ZERO new structure -> rejects 'MAX-collapse hid 5hmC clones'.

synthesis: modkit v0.6.3 installed to /big7_disk, ran on the actual HCC1395 modBAM, and cross-validated against the pysam r.modified_bases baseline with a clean PASS (per-read 5mC Pearson=1.0, 13805 shared calls, 0 modkit-only/0 pysam-only, verified-correct '?'-mode = 0/45332 inferred rows). modkit is a complementary, externally-citable extraction/pileup FRONTEND, not a replacement: no somatic-vs-germline ASM axis and no subclone clustering (those remain MSA and ISM territory). On the research question, GMM re-test on modkit separated-continuous beta produced essentially no verdict change vs pysam-binarized M2 (9/13 bimodal, 3 losses on small-n threshold-crossing, 0 gains, 0 new 5hmC structure), so the pysam MAX-collapse was not distorting the subclone picture and BRCA2 stays unimodal. The practical payoff of modkit is reviewer-grade provenance and elimination of the MSA double-row collapse bug at the measurement step, NOT a change to any subclone conclusion.
recommendation: ADOPT modkit as the citable extraction frontend (`modkit extract full --include-bed loci.bed --reference ref tumor.bam`) to replace ONLY the raw MM/ML measurement step and retire the MSA 5mC+5hmC double-row MAX-collapse bug; KEEP MSA for somatic germline-vs-ALT / HP-axis definitions and KEEP ISM for per-read subclone clustering. Treat the GMM re-test as NEGATIVE/NULL: do not re-open or re-grade subclone candidates on measurement method alone. NEXT: (a) wire modkit-extract as documented frontend into pipeline manifest with the cross-val log for provenance; (b) validate on a SECOND sample (COLO829) and report dBIC bootstrap/CI around the >=10 cutoff (the 3 flips are n-driven, not biology).
